posts.name: Pactio — The 30-Day Pact Challenge
posts.tagline: Make a pact. Keep it. A printable 30-day contract.
posts.description: No AI coach. No notifications. Just a pen, a paper, and a person who asks. Most goals die in week two. Pactio turns yours into a signed, witnessed contract — a printable 30-day workbook. Inside: a contract to sign, 30 daily prompts, weekly reviews, a completion certificate. DIY with your own witness ($12) or get matched ($9/mo). Missing a day isn't failing. Quitting is.

posts.name: RouteBudget EU
posts.tagline: Calculate real transport costs and profit before you drive
posts.description: RouteBudget EU helps truck drivers and transport companies know whether a job is profitable before accepting it. Instead of relying on rough price-per-kilometre estimates, calculate fuel, estimated tolls, driver costs, vehicle wear and empty return. See the real trip cost, break-even point, expected margin and minimum, recommended and ideal prices. Track costs during the journey and export a professional PDF quote. Available on iPhone and Android.

posts.name: TrackMCP
posts.tagline: Google Analytics for MCP Servers
posts.description: TrackMCP shows who is using your MCP server, what they are trying to do, whether the work gets done, and where to improve. All from one line of code.

posts.name: Present: Clock + Weather + Calendar
posts.tagline: Everything you need at a glance. Nothing else.
posts.description: Every other app wants your attention. Present just wants to give it back. No feeds. No notifications begging you to stay. Just the time, the date, the weather, and what's next — in a single glance. Because your hands aren't always free. You're getting ready for work, cooking dinner, halfway under the car in the garage. A quick look across the room shouldn't cost you ten minutes of scrolling. Present keeps you on track without pulling you in. Glance, know, and get back to your life.

posts.name: Bartholomew
posts.tagline: The sub-5µs transactional execution harness for AI agents
posts.description: Prompt guardrails fail when models get smart. Bartholomew is an inline execution harness for AI agents (Claude, Cursor) that provides atomic 2µs filesystem micro-rollbacks, in-flight secret scrubbing, and offline Merkle audit trails before your OS is touched.

posts.name: Fastvideosave
posts.tagline: Save public Instagram videos and Reels in seconds
posts.description: FastVideoSave is a simple web tool for saving public Instagram Reels and videos. Paste a public Instagram URL, choose the available download option, and save the media as an MP4 file. No Instagram login, app, or browser extension is required.

posts.name: Vireon
posts.tagline: ecommerce
posts.description: Vireon is a premium online shopping app where you can discover and purchase products across multiple categories. Designed with a clean and modern interface, Vireon focuses on making shopping simple, convenient, and enjoyable. Browse products, view details, add items to your cart, place orders, make secure payments, and track your delivery—all in one place. Vireon brings the convenience of platforms like Amazon and Flipkart with a more refined and premium shopping experience.

posts.name: Wipness Knee Patches
posts.tagline: Convenient knee patches for everyday pain relief
posts.description: Wipness Knee Patches are designed for convenient, targeted support when your knees need extra comfort. The flexible patch format makes them easy to apply at home or on the go, fitting naturally into everyday routines.

posts.name: Fiddle
posts.tagline: Everyone gets a task, except for one! Can you tell?
posts.description: A free, browser-based party game for groups playing together in person. Everyone but one player gets the same task to perform. The Imposter has nothing and has to fake it by watching everyone else. No app, no login: the host shares a link, everyone joins on their own phone, and the app handles dealing roles, running turns, and keeping score so the group can just play.

posts.name: DealPulse
posts.tagline: See where every sales conversation is leading.
posts.description: After every customer conversation, DealPulse analyses your sales call transcripts and tells you whether the deal is becoming stronger, weaker, or simply going nowhere. It shows which opportunities are worth pursuing, which need attention, and which are unlikely to close, so you can focus your time where it matters most.

posts.name: Tracer
posts.tagline: Capture, pin, annotate and translate on your Mac
posts.description: Tracer handles the everyday things that happen on your screen, quickly and cleanly. I wanted a tool that feels as natural as breathing. One shortcut, and what comes up is whatever the moment calls for. The fewest steps, nothing buried under menus, and the result is already in front of you. Most screenshot tools hand you a file and stop there. This one keeps the shot in front of you and keeps it useful. Everything else grew out of that. $3.99, one time. No subscription.

posts.name: GeoGames
posts.tagline: Daily challenges that merge geography with trivia
posts.description: Answer trivia questions with geographical locations instead of text. Players tap a globe and are scored based on distance. Every answer unlocks a story about the location. There's currently 3 games on one engine. GeoSports, GeoHistory, GeoFooty. All players receive the same questions daily and share scores with friends. Example below: GeoSports · September 3rd 887 / 1,000 🏆🏆🟢🟡🟡 www.geosports.app There are web versions for each game as well. In total we have roughly 75k unique players per day

posts.name: ActivitySweep
posts.tagline: Bulk unlike & delete your Instagram activity in your browser
posts.description: Clear years of Instagram likes, comments, reposts, and story replies without manual clicking. ActivitySweep operates Instagram's built-in bulk selection tool right in your browser—no logins, tracking, or remote servers required.
